C.title: C. Reading Comprehension
intro: Emma works for a medium-sized international company that sells medical equipment. She is responsible for customer service and often travels to meet clients. Last week, she went to Rome for a two-day business trip. Her flight was delayed, so she arrived at her hotel much later than expected.

The next morning, Emma met a client at his office. They discussed a new order and had lunch at a small restaurant nearby. Emma thought the restaurant was excellent. It was not as expensive as her hotel restaurant, and the service was much faster.

Emma is traveling again next month. She is going to Berlin for a conference. Her company has already booked her flight and a three-night stay at a hotel near the conference center. She plans to take a warm coat because the weather may be cold. If she has enough free time, she would also like to visit a museum.
questions: 1. What kind of company does Emma work for?
2. What is Emma responsible for?
3. Why did she go to Rome?
4. What problem did she have with her flight?
5. What did Emma and the client discuss?
6. How did the small restaurant compare with the hotel restaurant?
7. Where is Emma going next month?
8. How long is she staying at the hotel?
9. Why does she plan to take a warm coat?
10. What would she like to do if she has enough free time?

D.title: D. Listening & Summary
intro: Your teacher will read a short passage aloud twice. Listen carefully, then write a short summary in your own words. Include the main situation, important events, and the final plan or result.

E.title: E. Writing Task
intro: Write about a trip you took in the past OR a trip you are planning. Write a connected paragraph. Include:

• where you went / are going and why
• how you traveled / are traveling
• where you stayed / are going to stay
• what happened on the trip OR what you plan to do
• one recommendation or piece of advice for someone taking the same trip
Use a variety of Level 2 grammar and vocabulary.
